title: HELP put petrol in my diesel D-Max, getting married TOMORROW
where: KZN Bakkie Owners forum > Mechanical & Breakdowns

messages.author: Sizwe_DMax_Durbs
messages.body: Guys please I need help urgently. Filled up at the garage in Westville about 6pm, the attendant asked petrol or diesel and I was on the phone with my fiancee about the seating plan and I said petrol. 45 litres of 95 into my 2019 Isuzu D-Max 2.5 diesel. Drove maybe 3km, it started knocking and jerking and then died at the robot on Jan Smuts. I tried to start it again like 5 or 6 times, it turns but won't catch. Got it pushed into a side road. Wedding is TOMORROW 2pm in Hillcrest and the bakkie is supposed to carry the sound system and the cake. Is the engine finished?? Can I just top up with diesel and go? Please anyone

messages.author: Kobus4x4
messages.body: Ag shame man. Ja just fill it to the top with diesel, the mix will be fine, older diesels can run on a bit of petrol. My oom used to do it in winter. Drive slow and it will burn off.

messages.author: Tash_Ballito
messages.body: Congrats on the wedding first of all!! Second, I'm so sorry. My cousin did this and the dealer said the whole injection system was gone, it was like R40 000. Maybe borrow a bakkie for tomorrow? Hope it works out xx

messages.author: Sizwe_DMax_Durbs
messages.body: R40 000?? I'm going to be sick. Kobus should I try the diesel thing now or wait? I'm sitting next to it in the dark. Anyone in Durban who knows what they're doing please
